Replying to: none
Cc: none
Subject: none

@Lorna Villaruz, YOUR NMC PIN CAME THROUGH TODAY!!! 🎉🎉🎉 I am still smiling and I cannot type properly, I am so happy!! My best friend, my sister from another mother, is now officially a registered nurse in the UK. Thank you Lord!! And after about 20 years of me saying, “Lorna, come to Liverpool na!” she is really coming. FINALLY!!! 😂❤️

We trained together in nursing school in Iloilo and this photo of our capping ceremony in 1996 will forever be one of my favourites. Same hairstyle, same dream, same white shoes. Every single night in our dorm we polished those shoes, and every single night Lorna borrowed my polish because she never bought her own 😂 Lorna, almost 30 years later, please tell me you have your own shoe polish now?

After nursing school she went to Riyadh, then Dubai, and spent almost 18 years working there. All that time we stayed friends through all the distance and all the changes in our lives. When I left for the UK in 2004, she cried at the airport and told me, “Susunod ako, I will follow you.” Well, 22 years later, she really is following!! Better late than never, Charing haha. I am so glad we never let go of that dream.

She did her OSCE in Nottingham and I sent her a photo of the rain, just to prepare her for what is coming 😂 See, I am a very supportive friend. But seriously, after all the applications, studying, exams, waiting and praying, today is her day. Nobody deserves this happiness more.

And now for the important dates!! Lorna flies from Dubai to Manchester on 14 January 2027, arriving around 1pm. Then on 25 January she starts work on Ward 7 medical at Mersey Bank Hospital, with induction first and then her preceptorship. Liverpool, my best friend is almost here!!! 💃

Ward 7, you are so lucky to have her. She is honestly the best nurse I know. So calm, so kind, so dependable, and the patients always love her. She looks after people not only with her skills but with her whole heart. Her future patients and colleagues are getting somebody very special.

For her first month she will stay with us. The spare room is yours, Lorna, and Ben says okay, so it is official haha. No hotel, no problem, you are coming straight to family. Just please bring a PROPER COAT. Not a nice-looking jacket that does nothing. Liverpool wind is no joke, especially when you have spent all those years in Dubai heat! 😂🧥

Welcome also to our Filipino family here. There are so many people ready to meet you and help you settle in. We have Christmas parties and potlucks to look forward to, plenty of pancit and laughter, and next year you will be with us for Simbang Gabi too. You will not be on your own here, promise.

Lorna, from Iloilo to Liverpool, from our capping ceremony to your NMC PIN, look how far we have come. I am so, so proud of you. I cannot wait to see you, hug you, feed you and start this new chapter together.

Welcome home, my best friend!!! Liverpool is waiting for you ❤️🎉🇵🇭
